name: fhsweurope-battle_of_biak-coop-rec
description: FHSWEurope Battle of Biak-1944 co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only: whether a Catfish parked on the water loses hit points (ledger HP-21, fhswe-mechanics audit item 7). FHSWEurope's init.con adds FHSW, FH and Bf1942 archive paths, so the lab needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client FHSWEurope FHSW FH`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let the round run 20 min, then `lab.py stop`.
